end.summary:
Vihaan practised the structure of India’s courts and the idea of appeal.
They identified civil and criminal case examples, including property disputes and theft.
They explained that district courts are below High Courts and connected crime with harm to society.
They requested a diagram or image to support understanding.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised distinguishing civil cases from criminal cases and ordering district courts, High Courts, and the Supreme Court for appeals. They used property disputes and theft as examples and explained why the state may take up a criminal case. They repeatedly asked for a visual diagram, so at home you could draw the three court levels with arrows showing appeal from one level to the next.
